home.heroTitle: We Are Building Faith + Community In Suffolk
home.heroCopy: New Community Church exists to serve people at every stage of faith with Christ-centered teaching, care, and digital access to worship throughout the week.

about.title: A Community Of Faith Since 1997
about.intro: New Community Church was established in Suffolk, Virginia in 1997. We exist to help people know Jesus, grow in faith, and build meaningful Christ-centered relationships throughout the week.
about.identityCopy: We are followers of Jesus who are committed to biblical teaching, worship, and practical love for our neighbors.
about.rhythmCopy: Sunday worship and midweek connection create a steady rhythm for spiritual growth and shared life.
about.quote: Our common faith in Jesus shapes how we do life together through every season.
